svg.title: How Kinetograph makes a frame
svg.desc: Diagram of how Kinetograph makes a frame. A Remotion project (TSX) and a HyperFrames page (HTML) go into a bundle step with esbuild. In Node, the project runs for frame N (React, GSAP), then splits into layers and DOM islands. That goes as JSON to the Rust addon, which lays out and paints (Stylo, Taffy, Parley) and composites on the GPU (wgpu, Skia). FFmpeg encodes each frame to an MP4, with Web Audio rendered offline as a side input. A dashed arrow loops back from the encoder to run the next frame.
